Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds linked to document CHEMBL1142695. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by doc chembl_id. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require available canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
